## Claim
Fix the actual random-embedding RX/RZ code family, its fixed construction parameter ell, all actual redundant check coordinates, and the SAME deterministic decoder used to define the protected logical subsystem, including the whole level-2 terminal decoder of source §5.1.1. Let H0=sum_a J_a(I-S_a)/2, with known efficiently computable positive couplings in a fixed bounded interval.

There is a sufficiently large but fixed beta0 such that, for beta>=beta0 in any fixed finite interval, the classical Gibbs distribution on valid syndromes can be sampled to total variation epsilon in time polynomial in n/epsilon. Fixed-ell local preprocessing, gate tables, memory and precision are charged and may be enormous. This is a constructive ideal sampler, not a passive local thermalization/mixing result.

With a supplied encoded ground-state logical input and ideal application of the matched decoder's Pauli representative, it yields the thermal logical-encoding channel of the commuting model. # Actual RX/RZ binding to a zero-background trace-polymer sampler

2026-11-01. **Candidate binding proof for independent audit.** This addresses commuting, known-coupling H0 only. It does not claim passive single-site thermal mixing, a noisy loader, or preparation for generic noncommuting perturbations.

## Claimed constructive consequence, conditional only on the abstract trace lemma

The actual recursive decoder can be compiled into a uniform bounded-local-stencil, zero-preserving circuit which accepts exactly the valid syndrome space and whose marked execution size is at most A|sigma| for a constant A independent of system level. Its typed host has O(n) objects and bounded degree for fixed ell. Hence the root's full-stencil splitting/bijection lemma supplies an exact positive polymer gas with original activity exp(−beta E(sigma_gamma)). At sufficiently low fixed temperature, standard algorithmic polymer sampling gives a polynomial-time approximate classical syndrome sampler. The original couplings are never replaced by guessed renormalized couplings.

The ideal quantum preparation consequence is conditional on a supplied encoded input and applying the chosen decoder's Pauli representatives. Physical routing, ancilla/reset costs and noise are separate obligations below.

## 1. Fix the decoder; do not silently change its logical frame

The paper specifies admissible local corrections, not a unique choice among them. Before defining either the memory observables or this loader, fix deterministic choices satisfying ALL source conditions, including the outgoing-weight inequalities and zero-input correction0. A lexicographically first admissible correction is one possible constructive convention; it is not a replacement for a previously frozen different decoder. If a decoder has already been fixed, compile its SAME local choices and use its SAME terminal level-2 representative. Source counting arguments use zero-preserving local corrections; this normalization must be checked explicitly.

Each local gadget contains O(ell^2) cells with bounded parent incidence. Since ell is fixed, the admissible choice can be precomputed by a charged finite search, or implemented by the source's explicit local paths/pairings. The finite search may be astronomically costly in ell; it is not a claim of practical efficiency or polynomial dependence on ell as an input parameter.

# Reviewed implementation conventions

1 November 2026. These conventions complete the frozen texts without changing accepted executions or the stated scope. See independent_audit/ACTUAL_RECURSIVE_SAMPLER_BINDING_RECEIPT.md and ABSTRACT_TRACE_POLYMER_RECEIPT.md.

1. Every rejecting local test is a TOTAL deterministic gate: retain a nonzero reject flag and assign remaining outputs deterministically, for example zero correction/coarse outputs. Accepted executions are unchanged. Reject flags are a set of checked outputs, not an unpriced global oracle.
2. A gate is marked IFF at least one input is nonzero. Nonzero top input objects are marked IFF their bit is1. No extraneous gates, optional zero decorations or inconsistent label assignments are accepted. Every nonzero internal wire must have all its consuming gates included. Complete incident-wire stencils are mandatory even on cancellation gates.
3. Internal wires may be recorded inside gate stencils or represented as separate objects marked IFF nonzero, equivalently bounded identity-gate subdivision. Use one convention consistently. Their fixed multiplicity/fanout is charged in S and host degree.
4. Compile the SAME supplied/computable local correction rules and the SAME modified whole-level2 terminal decoder used by the logical frame. Finite-table preprocessing is charged, even if enormous. Do not swap in an unrelated convenient decoder.
5. The constructive circuit/host is supplied with polynomial construction cost. Near-linear established sampling uses preprocessed random-access local incidence and the source's computational model; finite-bit weights and probability generation are separately charged. The conservative polynomial fallback does not require claiming practical near-linear physical preparation.

7. Coherent logical SWAP assumes the incoming input/reference is initially independent of the old memory/bath state. The old memory may have arbitrary logical-gauge-bath correlations. Syndrome computation is uncomputed, not measured.
